_comment: Copy to config.json and add your Claude Max accounts. The rotator does NOT ship with any accounts — you opt in by populating this file via /ops:rotate add-account or by editing it directly. See README.md for details.

_account_schema_example.label: optional-disambiguator
_account_schema_example.orgName: Required Workspace or Personal Account Name

rateLimits.note: Max 20x defaults: ~220K tokens / ~900 messages per 5h window. extraUsageSafetyMargin: accounts with paid overage enabled rotate at 75% of their threshold to avoid incurring charges.

_magicLinkGmailAccount_note: Single Gmail inbox that ALL accounts' Claude magic-link login emails forward to. The rotator polls only this inbox (via gog --account) for every account's link, then disambiguates by target email. Leave unset to poll each account's own mailbox. Real value belongs in the gitignored override config or CLAUDE_ROT_GMAIL_ACCOUNT / GOG_ACCOUNT env, never here.

crs._comment: Optional: claude-relay-service (CRS) pool integration. Off by default — set enabled=true and install via scripts/install-crs-priority-agent.sh. Map each rotator account to its CRS row with crsAccountName on the account entry (or crs.nameByVaultKey). Admin password is NOT stored here: set $CRS_ADMIN_PASSWORD or credential-store CRS-Admin-<adminUser>.
crs._policy_note: conservative (default) deprioritizes on utilization/session warnings; max-out keeps accounts schedulable until genuine rate-limit or overload (util % is telemetry only). Override with $CRS_POLICY.
crs._thresholds_note: Legacy conservative thresholds (off/on/floor) apply only when policy=conservative. Default max-out policy keeps accounts schedulable until genuine rate-limit or overload; utilization % is telemetry only. freshMinutes = max age of claudeUsage trusted for secondary signals.
crs._logDir_note: Optional: crs-429-cooldown.mjs reads claude-relay-error-<date>.log from here (absolute path, no ~ expansion) for its optional lead signal. Defaults to <plugin-data-dir>/account-rotation/crs-logs if unset — point it at your CRS deployment's actual log directory. logTzOffset must match the timezone your CRS instance timestamps logs in.
crs._errorLog_note: errorLogWindowMs: how far back crs-429-cooldown.mjs scans the log for a 429 hit. errorLogCooldownMs: how long a log-only hit holds an account before rateLimitStatus itself would (default 5m each).
crs._stateDir_note: Optional absolute path (no ~ expansion) for crs-429-cooldown.mjs state/manual-disable files (crs-429-state.json, crs-manual-disable.json). Defaults to <plugin-data-dir>/account-rotation if unset.
crs._cooldownEnabled_note: Off by default (or $CRS_COOLDOWN_ENABLED=1). Turns on crs-429-cooldown.mjs, a fast (1min-cadence) reconciler that holds an account out of rotation only on a real rateLimitStatus.isRateLimited=true from CRS (plus the optional error-log lead signal under logDir/logTzOffset above) — never on utilization. Own state file at <stateDir>/crs-429-state.json.
crs._enableMagicLinkRecovery_note: Deprecated and fail-closed. Unattended reauthentication is disabled; use the signed staged-enrollment workflow. No environment variable re-enables direct auth writes.
crs._magicLinkRetryCooldownMs_note: Minimum time between unattended retry attempts for the SAME account, success or failure, so a persistently-broken account isn't retried in a tight loop (default 6h).
crs._magicLinkDispatch_note: Retained for config compatibility only. The autoloop never dispatches authentication; staged enrollment is required.
crs._magicLinkHeaded_note: Pass CLAUDE_ROT_HEADED=1 to the rotate child (default true). Interactive captcha walls need a headed browser on CLAUDE_DESKTOP_DISPLAY. Override with $CLAUDE_ROT_HEADED=0 only for pure headless experiments.
crs._magicLinkRotateTimeoutMs_note: Wall-clock ms before the autoloop kills a stuck rotate child (default 20m). Override with $CRS_MAGIC_LINK_ROTATE_TIMEOUT_MS. Captcha cascade (visual + desktop-act) needs more room than a pure token refresh.
